name: House
description: Warm, groovy and full: round kick, bouncy bass, chords and vocals in the mids, shiny but not harsh top.
notes: Kick + bass 50-120 Hz, warmer low-mids than techno for chords/pianos/vocals.
Top end open but smooth (shakers, open hats).
